title: A04 Auto Loader schema evolution cheat sheet
subtitle: ASSOCIATE EXAM PREP · A04 · SECTION 2 INGESTION (21%) · AUTO LOADER SCHEMA QUICK REFERENCE

pages.title: A04 · Auto Loader schema enforcement and evolution
lede: Objective: use Auto Loader with schema enforcement and evolution.
Free Edition: Unity Catalog volume source, serverless notebook, trigger(availableNow=True). Fictional orders only.

blocks.heading: 1. schemaLocation turns on inference + evolution
blocks.code:
df = (spark.readStream.format("cloudFiles")
      .option("cloudFiles.format", "csv")
      .option("cloudFiles.schemaLocation", chk)     # schema kept in chk/_schemas
      .load("/Volumes/workspace/bt_autoloader_xxxx/landing/orders"))
blocks.note: Inference samples the first 50 GB or 1,000 files. schemaLocation can share the checkpoint folder.

blocks.heading: 2. Default inference: strings
blocks.code:
CSV, JSON, XML    every column inferred as STRING (plus _rescued_data)
Parquet, Avro     types from the file schema (widest type wins on conflict)
cloudFiles.inferColumnTypes = true   -> typed inference (int, double, ...)
blocks.note: Strings by default so a changing value can't break a column type later.

blocks.heading: 3. Schema hints pin known types
blocks.note: Hints apply on top of inference, can add a column not seen yet, and are used only without .schema(...).

blocks.heading: 4. Write side: mergeSchema
blocks.code:
.writeStream
  .option("checkpointLocation", chk)
  .option("mergeSchema", "true")      # Delta table accepts new columns
  .trigger(availableNow=True)          # serverless: process files, then stop
  .toTable("orders_bronze")
blocks.note: Without mergeSchema the restart fails at the Delta write with a schema mismatch.

pages.title: Evolution modes, _rescued_data, exam traps

blocks.heading: 5. cloudFiles.schemaEvolutionMode
blocks.code:
addNewColumns (default)        fail once (UnknownFieldException), schema updated, restart resumes
addNewColumnsWithTypeWidening  same + widen types like int -> long (Public Preview)
rescue                         never evolve, never fail, new columns go to _rescued_data
failOnNewColumns               fail, stay failed until you update the schema or remove the file
none                           ignore new columns, never fail, no rescue unless rescuedDataColumn
blocks.note: Provided .schema(...): default mode is none and addNewColumns is not allowed.

blocks.heading: 6. Day 1 -> day 2 (new column channel + amount N/A)
blocks.code:
run 1  orders_day1.csv              -> 3 rows, typed
run 2  orders_day2.csv + channel    -> stream stops, schema location gains channel, still 3
run 3  same code (restart)          -> 5 rows, channel null for day 1 rows
       order 1005 amount N/A        -> amount null, _rescued_data {"amount":"N/A","_file_path":...}

blocks.heading: 7. What lands in _rescued_data
blocks.text: Type mismatches, columns missing from the schema, and case mismatches, stored as a JSON blob with the source _file_path. With a rescued data column, type mismatches don't fail the read; only malformed records do. Rename it or add it to a provided schema with the rescuedDataColumn option.

blocks.heading: 8. Five exam traps
blocks.text: 1) CSV and JSON infer strings unless cloudFiles.inferColumnTypes. 2) Default mode: a new column fails the stream once, a restart picks it up (run it in Lakeflow Jobs with retries). 3) rescue: no failure, no new column. 4) Provided schema: default mode is none. 5) New column in the Delta table: mergeSchema on the write.

blocks.heading: Practice challenge
blocks.text: Day 3 adds a coupon column. Default mode: fails once, then the rerun loads day 3 and mergeSchema adds coupon. rescue: no failure, no column, coupon in _rescued_data. Provided schema, no mode: none, coupon ignored, not rescued unless rescuedDataColumn is set.
